title: Snail, Inc. Sets Second Quarter 2026 Conference Call for Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. ET
summary: CULVER CITY, Calif., Aug. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Snail, Inc. (Nasdaq: SNAL) (“Snail Games” or the “Company”), a leading global independent developer and publisher of interactive digital entertainment, will hold a conference call and webcast on Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 4:30 p.m.

CULVER CITY, Calif., Aug. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- **Snail, Inc. (Nasdaq: SNAL) (“Snail Games” or the “Company”),** a leading global independent developer and publisher of interactive digital entertainment, will hold a conference call and webcast on Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. Eastern time (1:30 p.m. Pacific time) to discuss its financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.


Snail Games management will host the conference call and webcast, followed by a question-and-answer period. Participants may listen to the live webcast and replay via the link[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=AQxDlDteu3ATtMPdarhQGm4KD7oOmjilYcOAKCoQdGNqln9qXFzhYqzLjf2x8WLiZrPr94GzpUc1q6HSU70kFXROiZxWp0iDo4mUf1jr_r4=) or on the Company’s investor relations website at[https://investor.snail.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=rnNWzmIbNV8YTDd7ao1ug8NnWWpw9g2AcvmkltlJYbETvvtJ8lTY0OpVWaADouZk-4UYkl3JnsTjhfzNfWgJ7Uylx97vgHTzw35fk72iJPzgcxDuCxCOBhlnjlZzUUi2) .


**About Snail, Inc.**
Snail, Inc. (Nasdaq: SNAL) is a leading, global independent developer and publisher of interactive digital entertainment for consumers around the world, with a premier portfolio of premium games designed for use on a variety of platforms, including consoles, PCs, and mobile devices.
